name: Lexend
summary: Free variable font designed to improve reading proficiency, with the research behind it, a reading demo and downloads.
description: The site of Lexend, a variable font built on Dr. Bonnie Shaver-Troup's research into reading difficulty and designed to improve reading proficiency. It explains reading fluency measured in words correct per minute, includes a reading demo on the page, documents the font's history and offers a free download.
contains: free download of the Lexend font
interactive reading demo on the page
history from Dr. Bonnie Shaver-Troup's 1999-2000 work
OFL-1.1 license per the font's repository
